draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.weaknessQuote: Very short for an outside cornerback.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 91st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 10th of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 139, well after his grade rank (91st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tavon Young. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2019) ranked 1st in passes defended among the 27 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the Washington Commanders. 86 career games and 35 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 12 (88th percentile), season snap share 76.3% (80th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 18.8% (6th percentile), passer rating allowed 117.7 (10th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 cornerback who played: 76.3% season snap share against a median of 26.1%, above the norm.
